## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify any planned capability that remains unimplemented.

## Verification

List commands run, observed results, and any checks not performed. For behavior changes, describe the meaningful synthetic tests added.

## Coverage and limitations

State supported surfaces, ambiguity handling, and any privacy, structural, or RL-utility limitations.

## Project rules

- [ ] I updated `AGENTS.md` if this change alters project rules.

## Data review

- [ ] This change contains only synthetic examples and no customer data, secrets, model weights, or mapping vaults.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes working behavior from product goals.
- [ ] I ran the checks appropriate to this change.
